newsitem.title: UK: China Zhenhai sets $200 million convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: China Zhenhai sets $200 million convertible bond.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd has launched a $200 million convertible bond with a coupon indicated at 3.0-3.5 percent, joint lead managers ING Barings and Morgan Stanley said on Monday.
The conversion premium was indicated at 10-16 percent.

The December 2003 issue will carry an investor put option after five years which will be priced to yield 75-125 basis points over U.S. Treasuries. Atlantic Richfield Co was expected to "subscribe for a significant amount of bonds," the leads said. A China Zhenhai official has previously said the amount would be 20 percent.
Atlantic Richfield already owns 9.9 percent of China Zhenhai.
The bonds, available in denominations of $1,000, will be listed in Hong Kong and London.
